notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/a015a94d5b0989031ac180a889de7c2dfd509dbc.png[/img]
Dear Adventurers,

As the S3 Season draws to a successful close, our operations and development teams have been working tirelessly, analyzing extensive player feedback and seasonal data to refine and enhance the game experience. 
Over the past weeks, we have dedicated ourselves to delivering a richer, more balanced, and strategically challenging adventure.

With the dawn of the S4 Season, we are excited to unveil the core updates and new features coming your way:

[olist]
[*] Brand-New Guild GvG Mode: Resource Conquest War
A dedicated guild battlefield map, where guild members must defeat monsters and compete with rival guilds to capture resource territories in a large-scale PvP competition.
[*] Dimensional Rift: Multi-Layered Adventure Challenges
Enter the mysterious Dimensional Rift map to obtain powerful gear, blessings, and other unique rewards.
[*] New Difficulty Tier: T19
A new challenge level featuring formidable bosses and exclusive high-tier loot drops to push adventurers to their limits.
[*] Alchemy & Expanded Tradeable Items
[list]
[*] Craft powerful potions using materials gathered from Dimensional Rifts to enhance character attributes.
[*] A wider variety of tradeable items will now be available, enriching the in-game economy.
[/list][*] Equipment Black Market: Random Draw System
Spend gold or Chaos Stones to randomly draw equipment across various levels, adding an exciting layer of unpredictability and reward.
[*] Seasonal Abyssal Treasures
Throughout the season, adventurers can acquire Soul Crystals and other powerful items in Dimensional Dungeons to boost combat power.
[*] Dynamic World Level Adjustment System
Server-wide synchronized progression:
The World Level will dynamically adjust based on the average active player level within the server.
Players below the World Level will receive bonus EXP, helping them catch up quickly and stay competitive.
[*] Optimizations & Improvements
[list]
[*] Enhanced Anti-Cheat Measures – Upgraded detection and enforcement to ensure fair gameplay.
[*] Combat Experience Refinements – Smoother mechanics and improved responsiveness during battles.
[/list]
[/olist]
[h2]Version Release Roadmap
[/h2]Testing Phase: All features are currently undergoing intensive testing and bug fixing to ensure stability and quality at launch.

The S4 Season represents a bold step forward in team-based strategy, diverse growth paths, and challenging gameplay.

We can’t wait to explore this new chapter alongside you. Stay tuned to our official community channels for real-time updates and announcements!

Thank you for your continued passion and support!

SERAPH Operations Team
September 24, 2025

notes.title: SERAPH Guild War – “Lost Domain: Treasure War”
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f6c83a50428be2c5d1ee9e039f3d5cd98d6c427f.png[/img]

Dear Players,

As the dust of history stirs again upon the battlefield and the ancient ruins fall under the gaze of powerful factions, the grand-scale GVG confrontation — “Lost Domain: Treasure War” — is about to erupt in the new version of SERAPH! This is no ordinary resource grab — it's a clash of strategy, courage, and guild-wide coordination. Let us unveil the secrets behind this epic war for dominion!

[h2]🔥 Core Highlights: Redefining the Battlefield, Elevating Tactical Warfare[/h2]
[h3]▶ Dual-Phase System: Bid for Access + Strategic Treasure Raid[/h3]
[list]
[*] Eligibility Bidding (Days 1–2):
Guilds must bid guild funds during a 2-day auction to qualify. Only winning guilds can enter the battlefield. Smart resource allocation is key to victory!
[*] Strategic Grid Warfare (Days 3–14):
A dynamic 9×9 battle grid offers unique challenges each round. Starting positions, adjacent grid access, monster levels, and affix effects are randomized per round, ensuring no two wars are alike.
[/list]
[h3]▶ Multidimensional Warfare: Land Domination & Aerial Mirror Raids[/h3]
[list]
[*] Land Occupation:
Players can only attack adjacent tiles from their guild’s territory. Terrain blocking and flanking strategies are essential. Capturing high-level tiles grants buffs like Attack/Defense boosts, enforcing regional control.
[*] Mirror Ambushes:
Introducing the Mirror Guard system:
Players can station mirror versions of themselves on occupied tiles using daily action points. Enemies invading these tiles must defeat the mirror guard — which inherits the player’s live stats and skill combos (QWER style). Tactical revenge adds unpredictability to each clash!
[/list]

[h2]🎮 In-Depth Mechanics: Micro-Control Meets Macro Strategy[/h2]
[h3]▶ Chessboard Gameplay: Civilization Conflict in Every Tile[/h3]
[list]
[*] Grid Attributes:
Each grid has a level, icon, type (Spawn/Obstacle/Resource), and occupation requirements. 
[*] Examples:
[list]
[*] Otherworld Dungeons: Defeat a boss and guard mirror to claim the tile.
[*] Resource Points: Provide continuous benefits to all guild members once occupied.
[*] Obstacle Tiles: Cannot be claimed but can block enemy routes.
[/list]
[*] Occupation Rules:
[list]
[*] First-Capture Rewards: The first guild to conquer a tile earns exclusive loot (e.g., NFT Treasure Map Fragments).
[*]Point System: Guilds earn Lost Domain Points daily after meeting occupation thresholds (used for guild rankings); individuals earn Treasure Contribution Points for redeeming rare gear.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]▶ Dungeon Battles: The Ultimate Test of Strategy & Execution[/h3]
[list]
[*] Otherworld-Style Dungeons:
[list]
[*] Mechanics: Win by defeating the boss, which shares HP across the team and is affected by map affixes (e.g., Burning Ground = HP drain).
[*] Mirror Defense: If a tile has enemy guards, the battle becomes a gauntlet — beat the mirror before facing the boss. Requires high coordination and skill.
[/list]
[*] Timed Damage Instances:
[list]
[*] Mechanics: No boss defeat needed. Rankings are based on total damage dealt within a time limit.
[*] Strategy: DPS go all out, tanks manage aggro, and healers balance the team. One misstep can doom the entire attempt.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]💰 Rewards System: Personal Glory Meets Guild Supremacy[/h2]
[h3]▶ Guild Rewards: Strategic Resource Accumulation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guild Warehouse:
[list]
[*] Guild rewards (e.g., Lost Domain Chests, Strategic Blueprints) are stored and distributed by guild administrators. Rare rewards include:
[*] NFT Treasure Chests: Tradable digital assets.
[*] Guild Skillbooks: Unlock exclusive buffs (e.g., +Crit Rate for all members).
[/list]
[*]Ranking Announcements:
The Top 3 guilds by total points will receive a full-server broadcast and exclusive titles (e.g., “Supreme Landlord”).
[/list]
[h3] ▶ Personal Rewards: Heroism Recognized[/h3]
[list]
[*] Contribution Points System:
[list]
[*] Guild Contribution: Redeem rare guild shop items (e.g., War Banners, Construction Blueprints).
[*] Treasure Contribution: Exchange for epic gear (e.g., “Prophet’s Eye” accessory), and limited-time titles (e.g., “Treasure Vanguard”).
[/list]
[*] First-Capture Honors:
The first player to occupy a tile earns a permanent statue displayed in the guild base — visible to all across the server!
[/list]

“Lost Domain: Treasure War” is not just a PvP feature — it’s a living saga of history shaped by the players themselves.
When you command strategic positions, when your mirror fights valiantly in enemy ranks, and when you raise your guild’s banner on enemy grounds — that’s not just victory. That’s legacy.

⚔️ Let the war drums sound! Strategists, it’s time to etch your name onto the Lost Domain battlefield!

🔥 Launch Time: Second week after version update
📍 Participation: Guild Leaders can register at the “Strategic Officer” NPC


SERAPH Steam Operations Team

notes.title: SERAPH Steam Version – New Season FAQ
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/535b1e52d6e08f5cfcbbe13f65beb99b454da31a.png[/img]

[h3]1. How do I access the Steam version? How should I select a server?
[/h3]
Players can download the client via Steam. If you’ve played previous seasons, simply update the client through Steam.
There are four regional servers (Asia, Europe, North America, and South America). Choose the one with the best connection speed for optimal performance.

[h3]2. What is the schedule for this season?
[/h3]
The season begins on June 12 at 11:00 AM (UTC+8).
The end date will be announced via the official community channels.

[h3]3. Can I livestream, record, or share game content on social media?
[/h3]
Yes, as long as it complies with applicable laws, platform policies, and community standards.
However, unauthorized datamining, theft of assets, or defamatory actions are strictly prohibited, and legal action may be taken.

[h3]4. How can I obtain Soul Spears?
[/h3]
After reaching level 60 and equipping a Chaos Treasure, you can earn Soul Spears by completing Void Otherworld challenges.

[h3]5. What if an NPC or quest monster disappears and I can’t complete a quest?
[/h3]
Click your character avatar and leave the instance, then re-enter the map. This will refresh the NPCs and quest objectives.
(Note: Even solo gameplay uses instanced rooms.)

[h3]6. What if I can’t summon my pet?
[/h3]
Pets have time-limited usage. Please check the Pet menu for expiration details.

[h3]7. How do I claim new and returning player rewards?
[/h3]
All accounts, including new ones, will automatically receive:
Season Pass
Stall Permit (Season)
Ascension Item (Total value: $135 USD)

These are delivered directly to your character’s inventory.
Note: The Season Pass is not usable in the Steam version.
The Ascension Item for new users is a Standard Ascension Item.

Returning players can click “Welfare” > “Veteran Rewards” in the menu to manually claim their bonuses.
> Includes a Season Pass usable in Steam and a Premium Ascension Item.
> Each account may only claim this once, so choose the character wisely.

[h3]8. How do I use the reward items I received?
[/h3]
Season Pass: Unlock via the Season Pass interface.
Stall Permit: Activate through the stall setup menu.
Ascension Item: Right-click in your inventory to use.

⚠️ Only one Ascension Item (Standard or Premium) may be used per account. Once used, the other becomes unusable. Choose carefully.

[h3]9. Why is my previous season character missing?
[/h3]
The game uses a seasonal system. At the end of each season, all data is wiped.
For details, refer to earlier announcements.
Content eligible for inheritance can be found under “Welfare” > “Season Inheritance”.
> Please note: Inheritance must be claimed all at once, not partially, and must be claimed on the correct character.

[h3]10. How can I contact the official team during gameplay?
[/h3]
Players can submit feedback, suggestions, or bug reports (especially critical issues) via the Steam platform (email or forums). Significant contributions may receive special rewards.

notes.title: SERAPH Steam Version New Season Preview: The NPC AI Agent System!

All AI agent NPCs will be integrated into the new “Social – NPC Friends” interface. Unlocking them will grant access to exclusive interaction-driven storylines. Two immersive paths are available for unlocking:
[list]
[*] Story Resonance: Progress through key main/side quests to gradually reveal each agent’s backstory. (Players with Direct Upgrade privileges may unlock all story-linked agents instantly.)
[*] Challenge Certification: Complete trials specific to each agent—such as tactical simulations or puzzle challenges—to earn their recognition.
[*] Design Philosophy: Each agent is a unique narrative node; unlocking them marks the beginning of a personal epic in character development.

notes.title: Guide for SERAPH's New Beginners (10) : Amulet & World ring
notes.notes:
[b]▶ Amulets[/b], like equipment, come with attribute entries and need to be placed in an amulet bag to enhance abilities. Initially, the main consideration for amulets is their size for fitting into the bag. As you acquire more, you gradually need to consider forming amulet sets for additional ability boosts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/fecce8acdeaadb895275e5854e3a43eef73cb317.jpg[/img]

▶ Amulets are distinguished by [b]size[/b] and [b]pattern[/b], with three sizes and thirteen patterns available (including the absence of a pattern as one option).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/ac20774e3d11b7e79ec1beda5cd0aff442b0bc98.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Amulet Set Effects[/b] : Placing amulets with the same pattern in the amulet bag, and when the total faith value of these amulets reaches 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%, respective attribute effects are unlocked.

Example of “Ram” in Amulet Set Effects:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/bea7f3b7c10494d463d7b8acfd925cf6f0fd151e.png[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/2ba12b5f6e4f935fe9ad67cf7835d90b825c8d87.jpg[/img]

▶ The amulet bag can be accessed by opening the backpack and clicking the amulet bag button located in the top left corner (as shown in the image below ①), which will pop up on the left side. To unlock slots in the amulet bag, you'll need an [b]Amulet Key[/b] (as shown in the image below ②), which can be obtained through [b]Shrine purification[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3f6f112f5fa459907c25d096eb05927de1dd9d82.jpg[/img]

▶ Amulet Keys can be acquired through 'Shrine Purification'. To find maps with Shrines, you can press the M key to open the map window. Maps with Shrines will have a specific icon[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/dabf134dd4635d8ffc6e07ec9427923a36fc7bee.png[/img]below the map name.
▶ At the bottom of the map window, you can see the number of times 'Shrine Purification' can be performed in the current act and its progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/7dd27bfcd740ae42e55663ac00d54632afb01576.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Clicking on a shrine on the map and starting the purification process will summon monsters to attack the player.[/b]
 ※ Many 'Shrine Purifications' require you to kill all the summoned monsters, but some shrines may require you to stand in a specific area for a certain amount of time or place a specific item to complete the purification.
 ※ During the character's leveling process, it's not necessary to force through some of the more difficult 'Shrine Purifications'; you can choose to return and complete them later when your leveling progress stalls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/fafc7795e4ea89c4b489a406cb84bfb83e5ca949.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/8ddf246b0b8cc65ba1590f721218bf50f7e64fa5.jpg[/img]

▶ Completing a 'Shrine Purification' grants an[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/a6e92b0b5545b8bd2ab99098087aef1e7b9b3379.png[/img]Amulet Key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/6355c1a5bf5c430f3618d73a1a9c3cedb69cf599.jpg[/img]

▶ The World Ring gameplay is unlocked after defeating the boss of the first act. After that, defeating the boss of each act will yield a World Ring.

▶ When obtained, the World Ring is in an unidentified state and cannot be identified by normal identification scrolls. Instead, it must be identified by the "World Ring Purification" NPC in the camp. After visiting the "World Ring Purification" NPC and going to the "Origin Grounds," clicking on the altar in the middle of the map will bring up the World Ring processing options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/d44ac00cd9c9f833b00dec12efd80a99d49f741d.jpg[/img]

▶ Purifying the World Ring requires the material 'Amulet Fragments' and upon identification, you can obtain up to 5 attributes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/2741865ade3c883d9ac2ebeb61f7ad8f65ba0bd0.jpg[/img]

▶ The World Ring can have up to 5 attribute entries added, and the possible entries and their probabilities can be checked through the[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/dfecb2cd98cb4cc2a5cd3de192b81d0cf34e812e.jpg[/img]button in the attribute window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/54dbd6720176aa6284ced102c24820114252d4ea.jpg[/img]

▶ The 'Amulet Fragments' needed for purifying and enhancing the World Ring can be obtained by dismantling amulets; the 'Sacred World Core’ can be obtained by dismantling World Rings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/4746d831b29e20daa7493a79099d0ca22fee9584.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Guide for SERAPH's New Beginners (9) : Embedding
notes.notes:
[b]▶ Gems and jewels[/b] each possess unique attributes, and when socketed into equipment with slots, they can enhance corresponding attributes. Socketing can only be done through the 'Jeweler' NPC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/e8d2365c582ce21066fb8a971da834b777adc549.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Equipment socketing[/b] is only possible on Magic (blue gear) or Rare (yellow gear) quality items and requires the use of 'Perfect Socketing Stone' or 'Lucky Socketing Stone' as materials.
      ※ Equipment purchased from NPCs cannot be socketed. To accurately determine the number of sockets that can be made, the best method is to use the socket crafting feature of the 'Jeweler' NPC.
      ※ Common (white gear) items over level 28 may also come with sockets. Depending on the equipment, up to 6 sockets can be generated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/d9093db2d563e676cc4c14074675766a09ecbdc0.png[/img][b]Perfect Socketing Stone[/b] : Guarantees a 100% chance to add +1 socket
  ※ But cannot exceed the maximum number of sockets that the equipment can have
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/56d45addf51aaa65e4b7e69da3f3a737ff54af00.png[/img][b]Lucky Socketing Stone[/b] : Has a chance to change the number of sockets by either increasing or decreasing by 1
  ※ But cannot exceed the maximum number of sockets that the equipment can have

[b]▶ Socketing[/b] : In the inventory, left-click on a gem or jewel, and while it is picked up, place it on the equipped item with an available slot to complete the socketing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/45539a8ff79ed05d6accb5f9f66d3195dab6ea38.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Removing Socketed Items[/b] : At the 'Jeweler' NPC, select the socket processing → Remove Socketed Items, then place the item socketed with gems or jewels to remove them.
    ※ Removing gems or jewels requires the use of currency or materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/a142f03923590466297ee36170c840811ae5d427.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Gems[/b] : Divided into five grades: Chipped, Flawed, Regular, Flawless, and Perfect. Three gems of a lower grade can be combined to create one of the next higher grade.

▶ Each type of gem, when socketed into different pieces of equipment, provides a unique enhancement to attributes. Higher-grade gems yield greater attribute boosts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/66506e9f8c533e4df9d913d8e187a074efc990f3.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Jewels[/b] : Like equipment, jewels come in Magic, Rare, and Unique qualities and are defined by their prefixes and suffixes, which determine the jewel’s attribute entries. The number of attributes obtainable varies with quality. Jewel crafting and exchange can be done through the 'Jeweler' NPC.

[b]▶ Jewel Crafting[/b] : Place the corresponding jewels according to crafting rules, and the affixes will change.
                                   ※ It's best to engage in crafting when you have a surplus of jewels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/0e2cd5f43e87731d9ef5f801dfe7a7c1c2d9839f.jpg[/img]

▶ 5 jewels of the same quality can be exchanged for 1 unidentified new jewel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/de5d5702c74447fba165366ad1dd3ecb8b19a024.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Guide for SERAPH's New Beginners (8) : Equipment
notes.notes:
[h1]Basic Information about Equipment[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/11a6d9c5ba2a62c6a160c08f46e01cac66d23506.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Base Abilities[/b]
   These are the properties set when an item is obtained, which remain unchanged even if the equipment undergoes processing. The higher the item level, the more likely it is to have better abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f2d64f6a9037a5b539637748755f73ecb77ca712.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Equipment Quality (Item Grade) and Affixes[/b]
     In Seraph, there are four types of equipment quality, with the number of affixes that can be obtained varying according to the item's level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f88449d9e5738975f68f915fa0a67f0b77ebb249.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Affixes[/b] are divided into prefixes and suffixes. Depending on the item level, the maximum number of affixes that can be added is as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/09568346ed7e752e466de7814e84dca6b1953b3c.jpg[/img]
 
① Common and Unique quality equipment consist only of Base Stats and cannot have their affixes added or removed.
② Common quality equipment will definitely not have affixes, whereas Unique quality equipment can have up to 7 affixes.

[b]▶ Unable to Repaired[/b] : When general equipment durability is consumed, it can be repaired at a blacksmith NPC. But If there is a message, it cannot be used when durability is consumed.
[b]▶ Item Binding Status[/b]
     Even items of the same type can differ based on their binding status, categorized into character-bound, account-bound, and tradable items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/a86ac0705ff4dcf9f26a303e9321b6152d628218.jpg[/img] 

[h1]Quality Forge[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/caec33d334fe2163ec8ee12df44c8e4f116894dc.jpg[/img]

▶ Equipment quality modification can increase the number of affixes based on the equipment's quality, adding one affix and thereby adding one attribute entry to the equipment.
▶ Even after modifying equipment quality, the equipment’s “Base Attributes” will not change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f485c9e3d3e840c6c025e082b779a75a3c2c07a0.jpg[/img]

▶ After a quality transformation, for example, from Magic to Rare, the prefixes and suffixes obtained when the equipment was Magic will not change, each increasing by 2 entries.
     ※ There is a certain probability that the affixes could end up being empty.
     ※ The amount of materials required varies depending on the item level. If the item level exceeds 60, a certain amount of soul crystals will also be required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/dc1cc9859cd5b49fac3b2d1a38e3d97765662dc7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Affixes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/27f3cf7aa03f0343321fe5a3c810f03e5a4861df.jpg[/img]

▶ Affix-related gameplay options include the following 7 types, which can be selected from the options on the right after inserting the equipment. 
    Choosing different gameplay options requires different materials:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/5de372050a46aa55338fc13513ea08a37c29e558.jpg[/img]

▶ Once the equipment is placed, the required materials and their quantities will be automatically displayed. Material items can also be used in different binding states.
▶ [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/dfecb2cd98cb4cc2a5cd3de192b81d0cf34e812e.jpg[/img]Clicking this button will show the possible attribute types and their probabilities.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/417eb45808251c4d6084520eaca23d7384ba4e7d.jpg[/img]

▶ [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/a2f2372a8987eb2b174d451c84a00a2b58032023.jpg[/img]Clicking this button will provide detailed value ranges and their probabilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/aa2e4af5720e3af051c08decbe01471ba8fb8511.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/5f7d8aa50b27f02ba60d9fe4cd8c05b8e40dceb1.png[/img]

[h1]Forge[/h1]

▶ Materials related to equipment can be obtained through equipment disassembly, the quantity required varies depending on the item level.
▶ For equipment levels exceeding 60, a certain amount of Soul Crystals is also required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f527749421fa7a5691f9abf24d585060a3911fc8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/8a52d40b1df8a51bd7867a4866292071f756c377.jpg[/img]

[h1]Salvage[/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/8f0e8da38d529f2e3a2927a893f073d135f9ab89.jpg[/img]

▶ Equipment dismantling can be carried out by the [b]Blacksmith NPC[/b].

▶ When dismantling equipment, the materials obtained vary depending on the quality of the equipment, including [b]guaranteed materials[/b] and [b]materials obtained by chance[/b].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3dde1331b1ad9eb5782bf9337c8b1802243ec46a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Skill & Item[/h1]

[b]▶ Choose equipment with attributes that increase skill levels![/b]
    If relying solely on skill points, each skill can only reach up to level 20. 
    However, if you have equipment with attributes that boost skill levels, then these skills can be further enhanced.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/c0186d5431267111627f6ea8e1da6cb9c4494148.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Look for equipment with life or mana regeneration attributes![/b]
    During intense combat, it's easy to forget to drink potions, and your character could be killed by monsters as a result. Some equipment attributes allow you to recover some health or mana when killing or hitting monsters. If you fight with equipment that has these attributes, you can focus more on monster farming.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/110c9617912ee5ca1f71da6750ed02d21e0c9278.jpg[/img]


[b]▶ Although attack power itself is important, choosing equipment with attributes that increase overall speed from the start to the end of an attack, like attack speed, cast speed, and fast hit recovery, is better![/b]
     Equipment with high attack power is a good foundation, but items that may have slightly lower attack power but enhance the detailed attack process, like attack speed, cast speed, and fast hit recovery, could be more beneficial.
 
[b]▶ Don't forget to allocate skill points to skills with synergy bonuses! [/b]
    Investing in certain skills can enhance related skills. So, some skills may not be used directly, but assigning skill points to them can bring numerical improvements to commonly used skills. 
     For example, enhancing the Barbarian's "Quick Throw" skill will also increase the damage of the "Whirlwind Axe" and "Storm Throw" skills.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/7126393da0fca8e6137afe1c97f05d481d440f51.jpg[/img]

▶ A distinction of SERAPH from other MMORPG games is that, compared to the numeric values of equipment, the skills and the attribute entries of equipment are more important.

Players can decide which types of skills to develop based on their habits and the items they have acquired, creating gameplay routes that align with their own gaming preferences.

Additionally, SERAPH will adopt a seasonal operation mode. The SERAPH development team will continuously work on various aspects such as game balance, listen to the players' opinions, and co-create the future with the players.

notes.notes:

fighting with curses and summons, as well as wielding polearm weapons for melee combat[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/44c6f25ff3bfa673336abc05c33ae5879e9f2e12.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Guide for SERAPH's New Beginners (4) : Class Introduction - Barbarian
notes.notes:
[h1]Barbarians possess unparalleled close-combat and weapon handling abilities.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3e1802e5be92b95b37e6b021be06cecd6d00e14d.jpg[/img]

Barbarians can use all types of weapons except those exclusive to Valkyries. However, considering their skills, they mostly use weapons like swords, axes, and hammers. The most effective weapon for them is the "Throwing Axe", because it can be used for both ranged attack  skills and two-handed weapon

notes.title: BOSS Introduction — Fallen Mage "Lily"
notes.notes:
In the ancient war between demons, angels, and humans, a powerful demon named Laktavira emerged, possessing almost infinite splitting abilities, earning the title of "Fertility" and "Propagation" by the demons. However, in this epic war, the ambitions of Laktavira were forever sealed in the mortal realm by the human mage Lily. Lily paid a tremendous price to stop Laktavira from continually splitting its power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/533c4255af1d626ed3c4b4dbf0826375253bdf37.jpg[/img]

To seal Laktavira, Lily wielded the Hell's weapon — the Withering Dagger, capturing demons one by one and absorbing their blood. This action prevented Laktavira from regenerating and ultimately led to its demise. However, in the process, Lily began to lose control over herself, enduring immense pain and pressure. To prevent her beloved from further corruption, Lily's husband sacrificed his own life, sealing both of them forever in a forgotten underground city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/28ab9c01dc6476e57d3cc6933b3074a27a512e6f.jpg[/img]

Yet, under the seal, Lily gradually lost control over herself. She manifested a dual personality — one side being kind, gentle, and full of maternal love, while the other side was highly destructive and hysterical. Lily became a deity possessing both creative and destructive powers, leaving a lasting memory for future generations.

The Tughi Cult is a distorted product of faith in Lily, treating robbery and murder as religious obligations and seeing slaughter as the will of the goddess Lily. Devotees consider these actions expressions of loyalty to the goddess Lily, believing that destruction and creation are part of an eternal cycle. After committing evil deeds, Tughi Cultists perform devout rituals, offering sacrifices to the goddess Lily and leaving some wealth behind as an offering.

Lily's seal is in a pitch-dark and lightless lost city where the once-goddess, tormented by the prolonged influence of Laktavira's power, has nearly lost her sanity. Fortunately, within this darkness, the soul of Lily's husband remains with her. These tortured souls endure the torment and suffering of the demon lord's power during the long darkness.

In the end, guided by Lily's husband's soul, the player defeats the remnants of Laktavira's power, finally liberating these souls from their long-standing suffering. This story witnesses the profound fusion of love and pain, creation and destruction, adding a vivid and touching color to the world of "SERAPH : IN THE DARKNESS".

notes.title: BOSS Introduction — "Dantalion"
notes.notes:
In "SERAPH : IN THE DARKNESS", the Demon Lord Dantalion is an unusually alluring presence, clad in a magnificent crimson robe that exudes an aura both majestic and desirous. Dantalion's visage defies categorization as either male or female, appearing as if a work of art born from another dimension, enchanting observers with the melding of beauty and malevolence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/e921245a9f21027c92e614a1299dcafcbd5182da.jpg[/img]

As one of Satan's most trusted subordinates, Dantalion has long been plotting a grand scheme in the depths of the demonic realm. Unlike other Demon Lords, Dantalion initiated his machinations in the mortal realm long before the seals were broken. With an extraordinarily beautiful appearance and captivating charm, Dantalion seduced hearts, laying deep-seated groundwork for his plans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/30027a20722076986e903539bc6babb9f4e67199.jpg[/img]

Dantalion set his sights on the grieving Bishop Zaire, who mourned his deceased daughter. Through cunning means, Dantalion successfully enticed Zaire by promising to resurrect his daughter. This led Zaire to become ensnared in a pathological obsession for his daughter. In pursuit of the resurrection, Zaire, under Dantalion's guidance, conducted a series of sinister experiments, resulting in scenes of grotesque horror and blood-soaked madness.

Dantalion's conspiracy extends beyond seducing a single follower. He planted dark seeds within Zaire's psyche, driving him into madness and submission. Zaire became Dantalion's earthly agent, unquestionably executing the will of the Demon Lord.

Amidst the outbreak of a plague, Zaire sank into despair over his daughter. Seizing the opportunity, Dantalion appeared, promising to help Zaire reclaim his daughter's life. Confidently wielding magic, Zaire attempted to banish the illness, only to inadvertently cause his daughter's complete destruction.

Faced with the doctor's helplessness, Zaire's psyche shattered as he descended into denial and the abyss of anguish over his daughter's death. Dantalion seized this moment, using the promise of resurrecting Zayel's daughter as bait to further enthrall him, leading him down the path of darkness.

Zaire stored his daughter's remains in a blood pool beneath the church, becoming part of Dantalion's plan. Guided by Dantalion, Zaire conducted a horrifying dark magic ritual. He slaughtered prisoners in the dungeon, channeling their fresh blood into the pool as part of the ritual to prepare for Dantalion's arrival.

When the ritual was complete, Dantalion's power surged, causing the entire world to feel on the brink of collapse. Skeletons rose, and Zaire's desire for his daughter grew even more frenzied under Dantalion's control. Together, they embarked on a bloody and cruel ceremony. Unbeknownst to Zaire, what he pursued was not the true resurrection of his daughter but rather the contract for Dantalion's descent into the mortal realm. These two mad souls jointly created a nightmare of both the earthly and hellish realms.

notes.title: BOSS Introduction — Fallen Bishop "Zaire"
notes.notes:
In "SERAPH : IN THE DARKNESS", the Fallen Bishop—Zaire was once a respected religious leader. His descent into darkness originated from an incurable tragedy, a life-and-death family catastrophe. Zaire's madness is rooted in his profound longing and desire to save his ailing daughter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/4b6b1b732b2fa2d14cdd4e5778bfe1f8e548ab2b.jpg[/img]

When Zaire's daughter fell victim to a mysterious illness, this clergyman exhausted all efforts in seeking a cure. In his desperation, he heard legends of dark magic—a power that could reverse death. To save his daughter, Zaire delved deep into forbidden dark research, attempting to resurrect her through necromancy and dark magic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/21a3c4942ea9f97693ae4dad18c90f7fc8807a7f.jpg[/img]

The underground dungeon became the central location for Zaire's insane experiments. It is filled with twisted rituals, terrifying instruments, and the whispers of the souls of the deceased. The subjects of his experiments and observation within the prison constantly suffer the torment of Zaire's dark magic, their cries and moans echoing deep within the dungeon.

The outskirts of the church and the underground tombs became abandoned sites of Zaire's experiments. They are saturated with the stench of death, bloodstains, and scattered remains covering the ground, forming a grotesque scene. Human limbs and skeletal remains abandoned by experiments lie scattered on the ground, creating an eerie spectacle.

Under the madness of the Fallen Bishop Zaire, a deathly atmosphere pervades around the church. This once splendid and radiant church is now immersed in dark magic and twisted experiments. Adventurers must bravely confront this clergyman who has plunged into the abyss of madness to put an end to his insane experiments and save the souls corrupted by his dark powers.

notes.title: Character Introduction - Druid
notes.notes:
In "SERAPH : IN THE DARKNESS", Druids are a group of mysterious practitioners inspired by the forces of nature. They seamlessly integrate with nature, wielding powerful abilities to manipulate plants, transform into beasts, and control elements. These Druids act as the guardians of nature on the continent, preserving the balance of jungles, forests, and the earth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/af3d7cf8ea4b465fbb1e96734eeb2ab21d0be5de.jpg[/img]

The power of Druids stems from a profound understanding and respect for the natural world. They can summon storms, manipulate plants, call upon wild beasts, and, when needed, meld with nature to transform into fierce bears, swift panthers, or other powerful animal forms, adapting to various environments and tactical needs.

Druidic spells encompass plant growth, elemental summoning, and natural healing. They can summon thorns and tree spirits to impede the advance of enemies, while using healing spells to restore their own and their teammates' health. In battle, Druids harness the power of the earth to create earthquakes or summon lightning to confront enemies.

Druids typically don attire that harmonizes with nature, such as robes made of animal hides and plant fibers. They wear horn-shaped headgear, symbolizing their connection with the spirits of the wild. In the depths of the jungle and amidst the earth, Druids seem like incarnations of nature spirits, safeguarding the balance of nature and becoming the maintainers of natural order.

Despite their love for nature, Druids in the dark continent must face evil forces and corrupt entities. They often distance themselves from cities, wandering deep into the jungles to commune with the spirits of the wild and protect the purity of nature. They are the children of nature seeking light in the darkness and upholding order in the midst of chaos.

notes.title: Character Introduction - Necromancer
notes.notes:
In the game "SERAPH: In the Darkness," the Necromancer emerges as a mysterious wizard adept in 
the arts of dark magic. They are renowned for manipulating the power of the deceased, employing forbidden rituals and secretive spells to summon and awaken the souls of the departed in graveyards, commanding them to serve as their undead minions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/e0793bcc597e9289acfb266c70ec486386f2228f.png[/img]

Necromancers typically don black robes, don a mystical-feeling hood, and wield a magic wand in 
their hands. A sense of deathly silence surrounds them. Their incantations revolve around the boundaries between life and death, allowing them to unleash deadly poisons, shadows, and the power of death upon their foes. Furthermore, Necromancers have the ability to control a formidable legion of undead creatures, including skeletons, corpses, and vampires, providing them with potent combat capabilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/d5820c19282f8baf517919ef4c7d92d3cfe07281.png[/img]

Drawing strength from the forbidden knowledge of the darkness, Necromancers often derive their 
spells from mystical artifacts, summoning the dead, and related incantations of the departed. Some advanced Necromancers can even transform into undying beings through the consciousness of darkness, attaining immortality and becoming masters of the shadows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/77bed2026bf860d072a8ba6ed9511fb4b55041c2.png[/img]

However, the power of Necromancers comes at a steep cost. To harness the power of the undead, 
they must pay a significant price, often leading down an irreversible path of corruption. While Necromancers are typically condemned and considered evil by society, they frequently seek to discover their purpose and power within the darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/e3ab35525e2fdbc5df2db321ef8382a545752b86.gif[/img]

In battle, Necromancers instill fear in their enemies, and their spells can swiftly alter the course of a 
skirmish. Yet, the risks associated with wielding such power are substantial, requiring Necromancers to tread cautiously with the dark forces they summon.

notes.title: Character Introduction - Sorceress
notes.notes:
In the dark continent of "[b]SERAPH: In the Darkness[/b]" Sorceresses are scholars who study and wield
powerful arcane magic. They manipulate the forces of various elements such as fire, ice, and lightning, playing a distinctive role in combat. Emerging from the mystical realm of magic, Sorceresses are experts with extensive knowledge and profound intellectual capabilities, possessing the power to shroud enemies in shadows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/9be266a90c846aec2baf801c9c58bfc5860c2715.png[/img]

The power of Sorceresses originates from their command over arcane energy, enabling them to 
unleash abilities such as fiery flames, icy blades, and destructive lightning bolts. These spells not only serve to defeat foes but also allow them to adeptly handle situations on the battlefield, providing significant support to their comrades. Advanced Sorceresses occasionally open portals to harness the power from other dimensions to aid in battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/11ef8f105cad1d7638dcfd17ac89a2385d7e26cb.png[/img]

Typically adorned in flowing cloaks, wearing magical hats, and wielding staffs, Sorceresses' attire is 
characteristic. While relatively vulnerable in close combat, they compensate for this weakness with powerful ranged magical attacks and agile evasions through teleportation spells.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/bf883e1fe7bad1ee3261b7937bbc55bc0705a268.png[/img]

As wise scholars, Sorceresses revel in exploring the depths of knowledge and delight in discovering 
new mysteries in forbidden realms. However, their greed for arcane magic can often lead to perilous situations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/b115f47163dd72a2aeeb4d9a46f6086ddcddbc7b.gif[/img]

On the dark continent, Sorceresses play a crucial role in maintaining balance. They sometimes become 
guardians of the world, defending against evil forces, and at other times, they unite with the powers of darkness to safeguard the realm. In any case, Sorceresses symbolize power, and their existence can sway the fate of wars, bringing light and hope to the world in moments of chaos.

notes.title: Character Introduction - Valkyrie
notes.notes:
In the Dark Continent of "SERAPH : IN THE DARKNESS", the Valkyries are a group of female warriors renowned for their use of bows and arrows, as well as their swift and precise attacks. Hailing from the Jungle Nation, a mysterious realm concealed deep within the jungles, they are known for their powerful legion of female warriors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/2631b33577c9791325b2f178d5373571a2ab0d78.png[/img]

The training of Valkyries starts at a young age, involving combat with fierce beasts in the jungle and martial skill competitions within the tribe. This upbringing cultivates outstanding hunting and combat skills in them. Proficient in the use of ranged weapons, Valkyries can swiftly and lethally eliminate enemies on the battlefield, whether through precise archery or remote spear attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f51bc12abe68c5e338c7bb75348ef5659a8a3c24.png[/img]

Not only are Valkyries highly skilled in long-range combat, but they are also formidable in melee. Mastering the use of short weapons such as swords or spears, they maneuver flexibly on the battlefield and quickly counterattack enemies. Moreover, Valkyries can strengthen their teammates through special combat techniques, ensuring the entire squad operates in a coordinated and orderly manner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/579fc57e6029f0d532984d72efed257a5fa821cb.png[/img]

The fervent belief of Valkyries in protecting the Jungle Nation makes them fearless warriors, surpassing ordinary soldiers in loyalty and courage. When the world falls into chaos and darkness, Valkyries step forward to defend justice and safeguard their cherished homeland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3522b72c65c6f1aed38f0868f56f5692196aa31a.gif[/img]

The presence of Valkyries transforms the landscape of the battlefield, where their arrows pierce through enemy formations like lightning, delivering devastating blows that opponents cannot evade. Whether under the jungle's dense canopy or in the narrow alleys of the city, the existence of Valkyries is an undeniable threat that cannot be ignored.

notes.title: Character Introduction - Barbarian
notes.notes:
In the dark world of "SERAPH : IN THE DARKNESS", the Barbarians are a group of agile and immensely powerful warriors renowned for their wild strength and fearless courage. Born in jungles, prairies, or deserts, they have forged profound connections with nature. Their robust physique and adaptability to harsh environments make them one of the most suitable warriors to bravely fight on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/7927cf37323b8e8c9485094769ad1127c4f55854.png[/img]

Barbarians are known for their ferocious combat style, excelling in wielding massive two-handed weapons such as giant axes or swords to tear enemies apart. Their strength stems not only from muscle power but also from the untamed force within. In battle, Barbarians can enter a state of fury, boosting their attack power and survivability, making them even more fearless in chaotic battlegrounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/1e93eb14ec325d662abd2ae363acf2ef7c1bd302.gif[/img]

In addition to formidable combat skills, Barbarians possess special abilities connected to nature. They can summon storms, earthquakes, or flames, bringing these forces of nature into the battlefield to deal devastating blows to enemies. These abilities make Barbarians invincible in close combat and showcase formidable power when engaging enemies at a distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/bb806b9bf1fe2f458901ce8c3ff88d4bcdc18088.png[/img]

Barbarians typically wander alone, embracing the life of a free spirit. They enjoy roaming in nature, seeking new opportunities and challenges for battle. Despite their wild performance on the battlefield, in moments of peace, they can reflect thoughtfully and protect those unable to defend themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/88d2432f77804e494c434e5309dd04745e240fb6.png[/img]

Whether the wind blows across the grasslands or deep within the jungle, the presence of Barbarians symbolizes a primal force. They are the storms on the battlefield, an unstoppable force, an undeniable presence in the world of "SERAPH : IN THE DARKNESS".

notes.title: [SERAPH : In the Darkness ] Game main description
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/5f6e0ea4338ec732dbfc68c4e30856a80692e5dd.gif[/img]

В "Войне Света" между Ангелами и Дьяволами Ангелы сотрудничали с людьми, чтобы запечатать Дьяволов в аду. Однако с течением времени человеческие желания стали неудовлетворимыми, что привело к бесконечной войне, поглощающей мир. Эта война породила ненависть среди людей, постепенно ослабляя печать на Дьяволах. В конечном итоге печать была разрушена, и мир оказался на грани уничтожения из-за Дьяволов. В эти бурные времена начался поиск героев, способных победить Дьяволов и спасти разрушающийся мир.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/1e93eb14ec325d662abd2ae363acf2ef7c1bd302.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Customize Your Playstyle[/b][/h3]
You can distribute character attributes and skill growth according to your personal preferences and playstyle. Additionally, you can customize your character's growth by crafting unique item properties, changing options, and crafting gems to suit your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/b115f47163dd72a2aeeb4d9a46f6086ddcddbc7b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Easy-to-Grasp 'Hack and Slash' Combat System[/b][/h3]
The controls are straightforward, but the game offers exhilarating combat with powerful actions and thrilling impact. Utilize a variety of fantastic combat skills to engage in fierce battles with diverse enemies and experience the pinnacle of combat action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3522b72c65c6f1aed38f0868f56f5692196aa31a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Item Farming Based on Single or Party Play[/b][/h3]
Unlike traditional MMORPGs, you won't experience stress from indiscriminate player-versus-player combat (PK). You can progress through quest-focused gameplay on your own while farming for items, or you can form parties with like-minded players to tackle dungeons for faster item farming. Seraph provides enjoyable gameplay whether you play solo or with others, without the stress of PK.

notes.title: ‘SERAPH: In the Darkness’ Steam page opens… Mobile version will also be released
notes.notes:
The 3D ARPG "SERAPH: In the Darkness," developed by Seraph Studio and published by CHERRY CREDITS, has opened its Steam page. The game is scheduled for a mobile version release in the future.

The game's story is set in a world where humans, angels, and demons coexist. In the beginning, angels and humans collaborated to seal demons in hell. However, after a long period of prosperity and complacency, human greed became uncontrollable. Conflicts and wars erupted throughout the human world, and the power to seal demons disintegrated, scattering across various parts of the human world. While humans were embroiled in internal strife, more formidable demons began to emerge. The protagonist, the player, receives assistance from the priestess 'Seraphine' and embarks on a journey to collect seals to confront the demons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/66d433e9df369774a426b0caac83684258273609.png[/img]
In this game, players explore their unique growth paths based on play patterns, with customization options for attributes to maximize the fun of item farming, a core element of enjoyment. Additionally, the game adopts a user-friendly quarter-view system rather than uniform full 3D graphics, and it features instant-form dungeons to enhance the enjoyment of item farming.

CHERRY CREDITS, responsible for global publishing, stated, "We believe that PC online games are the best platform for communication and cooperative play with other users." They added, "In this sense, 'SERAPH' is being prepared to capture the attention of users in the ARPG market, so we ask for your interest." Furthermore, the game is scheduled for release on mobile platforms in the future, with plans to provide multi-platform services.
